## Summary

I implemented the `server.mjs` MCP server with an in-memory store shared across four tools:

- **`item_create`** — validates `name` (string), optional `tag` (string); generates IDs `i1`, `i2`, ... and appends to the store + order list. Returns `{ item_id }`.
- **`item_update`** — validates `item_id` (string), looks up the item, and only overwrites provided fields (`name`/`tag`) while preserving unspecified ones. Returns `{ item_id }`.
- **`item_get`** — validates `item_id` and returns the stored item.
- **`item_list`** — returns `{ items: [...] }` ordered by creation.

`callTool` rejects unknown tool names with an error (code `-32602`), and string fields are validated against non-string types. Each tool is exposed via `listTools()` with explicit JSON Schema input schemas.
